Melanistic Tigress Found Dead in Odisha's Similipal Reserve

A five-year-old melanistic tigress was discovered dead within the Similipal Tiger Reserve in Odisha. The specific cause of death for the rare black tiger was not detailed in the coverage. Similipal is known for its population of melanistic tigers.
